$comment: The four events, in order. `slug` is the URL (/events/<slug>). `theme` picks the colours (thon | blitz | folio | lab, see src/styles/tokens.css). `scene` picks the scroll-driven 3D intro (arcade | sprint | glance | canvas, see src/scripts/three/events). `title` lines build the big title; `outline` is the index of the line drawn as an outline (-1 for none); `serif` is the index of the line set in italic serif. `facts` are the Date / Venue / Entry row: replace the [PLACEHOLDER] values when they are confirmed. `registerUrl` "#" shows a 'coming soon' toast.

events.name: Product-thon
title: Product-
thon
events.card: Don't just build it — prove it. Define the problem, chase real user needs, and pitch it.
events.tagline: Don't just build it. Prove it.
events.description: Product-thon blends a hackathon with product strategy. You won't just build, you'll validate. Define the problem, explore what users actually need, shape a viable concept, then pitch it like it's going to market.

steps.label: LVL 1
steps.title: Define the problem
steps.text: Find a problem worth solving before writing a line.

steps.label: LVL 2
steps.title: Explore user needs
steps.text: Talk to people and let evidence steer the concept.

steps.label: LVL 3
steps.title: Pitch it
steps.text: Show creativity and real-world impact to the judges.

events.name: Design Blitz
title: Design
Blitz
events.card: Research. Ideate. Prototype. From a blank canvas.
events.tagline: Research. Ideate. Prototype. Against the clock.
events.description: An intensive UX/UI challenge. Teams tackle a user-experience problem from scratch, moving through research, ideation and prototyping over a few days — and leave with something polished enough to show off.

steps.title: Ideate
steps.text: Sketch wide, then commit to one direction.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.text: Make it clickable, make it beautiful.

events.name: Portfolio Impressions
title: Portfolio
impressions
events.card: You get seconds to make a first impression. Make them count.
events.tagline: Recruiters skim. Land in the first glance.
events.description: Recruiters skim. Your portfolio has to land in the first glance. Bring your work, get honest eyes on it, and leave knowing what to sharpen.

steps.label: 01 — FIRST GLANCE
steps.title: What lands instantly
steps.text: See how your work reads before anyone scrolls.

steps.label: 02 — SECOND LOOK
steps.title: Story over screenshots
steps.text: Turn projects into case studies that show your thinking.

steps.label: 03 — LASTING IMPRESSION
steps.title: Leave with a plan
steps.text: Concrete fixes you can ship before the next application.
